events.title: Pope Paschal II recognises the Knights Hospitaller
events.description: The bull Pie postulatio voluntatis placed the hospital of St John in Jerusalem under papal protection. The order later took on a military role and survives today as the Sovereign Military Order of Malta.
events.html: The bull Pie postulatio voluntatis placed the hospital of St John in Jerusalem under papal protection. The order later took on a military role and survives today as the Sovereign Military Order of Malta.

events.title: Galileo Galilei is born in Pisa
events.description: Galileo's telescopic discoveries, including Jupiter's moons, and his studies of motion made him a founder of modern physics. His defence of Copernicus brought his trial by the Inquisition in 1633.
events.html: Galileo's telescopic discoveries, including Jupiter's moons, and his studies of motion made him a founder of modern physics. His defence of Copernicus brought his trial by the Inquisition in 1633.

events.title: USS Maine explodes in Havana harbour
events.description: An explosion sank the American battleship, killing some 260 men. The cause is still debated, but US newspapers blamed Spain, and the cry 'Remember the Maine' helped bring war in April.
events.html: An explosion sank the American battleship, killing some 260 men. The cause is still debated, but US newspapers blamed Spain, and the cry 'Remember the Maine' helped bring war in April.

events.title: Singapore surrenders to Japan
events.description: General Arthur Percival surrendered Singapore, and some 80,000 British, Indian and Australian troops became prisoners. Churchill called it the worst disaster and largest capitulation in British history.
events.html: General Arthur Percival surrendered Singapore, and some 80,000 British, Indian and Australian troops became prisoners. Churchill called it the worst disaster and largest capitulation in British history.

events.title: US figure skating team killed in the Sabena air crash
events.description: Sabena Flight 548 crashed on approach to Brussels, killing all 72 aboard and a man on the ground. Among the dead was the entire US figure skating team, en route to the world championships in Prague.
events.html: Sabena Flight 548 crashed on approach to Brussels, killing all 72 aboard and a man on the ground. Among the dead was the entire US figure skating team, en route to the world championships in Prague.

events.title: Canada raises its Maple Leaf flag
events.description: The red and white Maple Leaf flag was raised on Parliament Hill in Ottawa, replacing the Canadian Red Ensign. 15 February is now marked as National Flag of Canada Day.
